deploymentEvidence.description: Current official frontend publishes Ethereum USDT own Nawa vault at exact proxy address. Its retirement predicate includes core and zig, not usdt; USDT is listed with deposit/redeem/withdraw tabs. This is not an admission of CORE/ZIG or bridge-token helpers.

abiEvidence.note: Complete ABI/source is the current resolved deployed NawaUSDTVault implementation, not the frontend ABI, a generic ERC4626 interface or initial implementation.

lifecycleEvidence.note: USDT current own financial product; other-chain retirement flags are not generalized to it.

lifecycleEvidence.excerpt: Secure, Shariah-compliant stable and liquid-staking vaults with transparent onchain yield.
lifecycleEvidence.note: Official site metadata and full currently loaded app assets retained. Marketing descriptions are not financial safety attestations.

configurationObservations.note: Independent latest-state reads sampled near the recorded block, not an atomic block-pinned bundle. AUM, cap, role and pause observations are point-in-time only.

selectedMethodReview.cancelRequest(uint256): Restores only caller's own still-Pending burned shares after stored settlement window.
selectedMethodReview.claim(): Pays only caller accrued financial redemption/reward entitlement to caller; no authority over another account.
selectedMethodReview.claimFor(address): Settles existing credited redemption entitlement only to its recorded user; caller cannot redirect the payout.
selectedMethodReview.deposit(uint256): Caller-funded USDT deposit; mints caller financial shares and nets approved redemption liabilities before forwarding surplus.
selectedMethodReview.depositWithMinShares(uint256,uint256,uin: Caller-funded USDT deposit with minimum minted shares and deadline; same fixed financial accounting as deposit.
selectedMethodReview.processQueue(uint256): Bounded permissionless FIFO funding of existing approved financial redemption liabilities from already-idle vault assets; no arbitrary target, recipient or approval control.
selectedMethodReview.requestRedeem(uint256): Burns only caller shares into a caller-owned priced Pending redemption request; no delegated spending or immediate payout.
selectedMethodReview.requestRedeemWithMinAssets(uint256,uint2: Burns caller shares into its own redemption request with deadline and request-time minimum asset protection; approval can still override bounded pricing.

sourceSemantics.funding: _deposit safeTransferFrom(msg.sender); _mint(msg.sender); burns own shares for request, claim only recorded entitlement. No arbitrary executor, callback/program data, backend signature or wallet authority input.
sourceSemantics.pricingAndUnits: USDT/share decimals=6, PPS_SCALE=1e18. Both conversions floor Math.mulDiv with +1 asset/+1 share offsets. NAV is stored manager-reported accounting, not onchain strategy balance.
sourceSemantics.operatorDependencies: Redeem-manager approval and bounded repricing, mutable fundsManager, AUM updater, guardian, backstop and UUPS upgrader are retained as unresolved operational/financial trust dependencies, not admitted caller authority.
sourceSemantics.fees: Official frontend states 15% performance fee net-of-yield strategy; selected code has no explicit per-call fee deduction.
sourceSemantics.queues: Pending request burns own shares, approval can override within configured cap, FIFO funding only credits recorded users. claimFor cannot redirect. cancellation re-mints shares only after pending deadline.

Ethereum Nawa USDT Vault proxy 0x6fe78b942c566fe2b8d0881cf3577c1b1511f204 only; EIP-1967 implementation 0xabba41142d2bf47a847987603347f94120d45043 was resolved by Sourcify and the implementation storage slot. Both report exact_match. UUPS upgrade and operational roles remain mutable; no role or upgrade authority is admitted.

This is Nawa's own deployed financial share/credit-accounting vault, not a bridge token or merely a curator label on another admitted protocol. The official current USDT product names Ethereum and ZIG Markets as curator; CORE/ZIG retirement flags do not classify USDT as retired. No other-chain surface is admitted.

Deposits pull USDT only from msg.sender, mint shares only to msg.sender, fund approved redemption liabilities first and forward surplus to the mutable fundsManager. The strategy and offchain private-credit counterparties, reported NAV, legal enforceability and recovery were not independently attested. Source/ABI verification is not private-credit backing verification.

USDT and share amounts use 6 decimals; price-per-share scale is 1e18. Deposit shares floor amount*(supply+1)/(latestAum+1); redemption assets floor shares*(latestAum+1)/(supply+1). Stored manager-reported AUM, minima, cap and NAV freshness apply. Bounded methods add deadline and minimum output; plain methods have no slippage/deadline protection.

requestRedeem burns only caller shares and creates a Pending request, not immediate cash. The redeemManager must approve, may apply a bounded NAV override, and can reject/remint shares. requestRedeemWithMinAssets bounds request-time pricing, not the final approved payout. Approval, queue funding, strategy liquidity, payment date and full exit are not guaranteed.

claim pays only msg.sender accrued claimable; claimFor(user) pays only that same user and grants no caller withdrawal authority. processQueue(maxIterations) only funds existing FIFO approved liabilities from idle vault USDT; it cannot approve/reprice requests or redirect recipients. cancelRequest only restores the caller's own still-Pending burned shares after the stored settlement window, not cash.

The official product describes a 15% performance fee on yield; selected deployed bodies do not implement an explicit per-call fee deduction. Do not treat marketing APY, 1:1 principal recovery, withdrawal timing or risk labels as guaranteed. Fees/losses may enter reported NAV.

Point-in-time RPC observations showed paused=false, outflowsFrozenUntil=0, nonzero fundsManager, positive AUM, cap headroom and last AUM update within maxAumAge. These latest-state samples are not enduring availability guarantees. Pause blocks deposits/requests; a guardian outflow freeze can defer claim/funding even while those remain separately callable.
